name: Net realisable value
expression: NRV = Estimated selling price − Completion costs − Selling costs
meaning: A source-defined inventory measurement or analysis relationship.
intuition: Connects inventory cost allocation or carrying value with reported performance and comparison.
workedExample: See the corresponding numbered worked example in the lesson.
commonMistake: Applying a framework rule or cost-trend direction without first identifying the method and facts.
relatedLearningOutcome: describe the measurement of inventory at the lower of cost and net realisable value and its implications for financial statements and ratios

name: US GAAP market bounds
expression: Floor = NRV − Normal profit margin; Market = median(Floor, Replacement cost, NRV)
